notablePrerequisites:
You control at least eight Treasures.
You control a basic Forest.
description:
Activate eight Treasures you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating eight Treasure tokens and eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
